feedback: Can you make sure the walls and floors are connected, and can you make sure spikes don't only spawn near ledges?

selection.reason: The resetGame function typically contains the procedural generation logic for the level, which is where we can adjust the placement of walls, floors, and spikes to meet the feedback requirements.

patch.notes: Extended horizontal floor generation from x=0 to x=20 so that platforms cleanly merge with side boundary walls, and updated the vertical dividers to use continuous blocks spanning between floors. Also changed the spike spawning check to iterate through all standard floor blocks to allow them to spawn anywhere on available floor space, not just directly adjacent to gap ledges.
